name: DriveMy practice yard (the ARM yard, traced)

site.ground: grass everywhere that is not pavement

photo_scale.note: Metres per pixel of bar/circuit/reference_aerial_grid.png (120 m across, +/-5%)

kerb_w.note: Kerb width; the kerb sits outside the pavement edge

wall_w.note: Kerbed wall along the sides of the hill and the ramp

corner_r.note: Island corners are rounded about 0.5 m; the Z inner corners about 1 m

turn_r.note: Route turn radius (the Swift turns at 3.43 m at full lock)

hill_w.note: Hill strip, kerb to kerb (real strip 26.6 x 4.6 m)

hill_top.note: Flat top: 25.75 total - 2 x 10.8 (PRD hill length)

hill_rise.note: Rise 1.3 m, 12.0% (v1 value, kept on 14 Oct: no public JPJ gradient found)

hill_stop.note: Yellow stop band at 33% of the rise

side_pocket_l.note: Side-parking pocket in the bottom-left island, along the band

pole_out.note: Poles at the four bay corners, 0.3 m outside the lines (guides: touching a pole fails)

par_slot_l.note: Parallel recess in the top-left island, along lane A-B

par_box_w.note: Painted parking box inside the recess, against its kerb, 6.6 x 2.5 m (v1 value, kept on 14 Oct)

tpt_w.note: Three-point-turn lane: the real lane beside the Z, decided on 14 Oct to be the three-point-turn lane; inside the car-derived 6.0-9.5 m window

s_w.note: S lane, kerb to kerb (real p10-p90 3.35-3.76 m, median 3.6 m)

s_r.note: S centreline radius (real median 7.5 m and 7.1 m)

z_w.note: Z lane, kerb to kerb (real 3.9-4.0 m)

z_jog.note: Z middle leg, lane centre to lane centre (real 7.7 m)

z_fillet.note: Z inner corners rounded about 1 m; outer corners square

z_rc.note: Route centreline radius through each Z corner (>= full-lock 3.43 m)

ramp_mouth.note: Flat run-in from the lane to the foot of the slope

ramp_rise.note: Platform height: a 10% slope up onto a raised block (a DA learner: naik atas batu simen)

ramp_top.note: Platform length to the end wall

ramp_pole_in.note: The pole stands on the centreline this far before the end wall (a DA learner: one pole in the middle)

ramp_site.note: The real yard has no ramp; the blueprint draws a structure on the open top-right floor, so the ramp stands there, in line with the hill

pavement_rule: even-odd: rings[0] is the yard edge; every other ring is a hole (an island or a wall)

kerbs.placement: each ring is a pavement edge; the kerb sits on the grass side, inner face on the ring

slopes.sides: solid walls from the ground to the deck; kerbs run on the deck edges
solid walls from the ground to the deck; kerbs run on the deck edges; the platform ends at a wall

stop_band.note: painted yellow; the front wheels must stop on it

stations.title: Side Parking
stations.manoeuvre: drive west along the band past the bay, reverse into it, then drive out and back east

bay.note: painted box against the recess kerb; the recess itself is 3.77 m deep

stations.title: 3-Point Turn
stations.manoeuvre: drive south into the lane, turn round in three movements, drive back north

stations.title: Ramp Test
stations.manoeuvre: turn right into the ramp, drive up, stop short of the pole, hold still, reverse down and out, then carry on north
